title: Two Luxe Downtown Homes
description:
✦ Your ultimate Nashville getaway awaits! ✦

Experience Music City in style at these TWO side-by side downtown homes thoughtfully curated for an unforgettable stay! 

✦ Key Highlights ✦

• Two side-by-side homes - 10 rooms!
• Centrally located - minutes to Broadway & other hotspots
• Perfect for a bach bash, family getaways, or friends' trips
• Private rooftop decks - ideal for group photos & memories!
• Attached 2-car garages + flex spots +  street parking 

Book Your Stay now! 🎸

The space
✦ Stay in luxury and comfort at these beautifully designed downtown homes nestled in Wedgewood Houston, one of Nashville’s most desirable neighborhoods. Whether you’re gathering your gang for a bachelor/bachelorette bash, planning a fabulous friends' trip, or bringing the family together for a music-filled escape, this is your ideal destination! 

✦ Prime Location - Centrally located and just a quick ride to Broadway, The Gulch, Ryman Auditorium, Bridgestone Arena, Nissan Stadium & all the other hotspots

✦ Community Perks - Guests enjoy access to a gas fire pit and BBQ grills, perfect for gathering after a day of enjoying the city

✦ Private Rooftop Decks - Take in panoramic city views, relax on the lounge seating, or toast to a perfect night while enjoying the Nashville skyline

✦ Amenities You’ll Love
• Private rooftop decks with downtown views, fireplace, and lounge seating
• Fully stocked chef’s kitchens with stainless steel appliances and a coffee station
• Hotel-quality linens and room-darkening curtains for a restful sleep
• High-speed internet and streaming Smart TVs throughout the homes
• Top-of-the-line washer & dryer and hypoallergenic detergent
• Keyless entry for easy access and check-in / check-out
• Hair dryers in every bathroom, iron, and ironing board
• Attached 2-car garage + plenty of free street parking
• Spacious walk-in closets with luggage racks
